license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to act as a real estate broker, managing broker, or real estate firm without first obtaining a license therefor, and otherwise complying with the provisions of this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the Washington department of licensing.

name.quote: "Department" means the Washington department of licensing.

type.quote: The director shall enforce all laws and rules relating to the licensing of real estate firms, brokers, managing brokers, and designated brokers, grant or deny licenses including temporary licenses to real estate firms, brokers, and managing brokers, and hold hearings.

age_minimum.quote: Is 18 years of age or older;

moral_character_required.quote: Furnish other proof as the director may require concerning the honesty, truthfulness, and good reputation, as well as the identity, which may include fingerprints and criminal background checks, of any applicants for a license

degree_required.value: High school diploma or its equivalent
degree_required.quote: Has a high school diploma or its equivalent;

degree_level.quote: Has a high school diploma or its equivalent;

school_approval_basis.quote: the real estate commission may certify courses of instruction other than in the aforementioned institutions

credential_pegged.quote: has furnished proof, as the director may require, that the applicant has successfully completed 90 hours of instruction in real estate

required.quote: The minimum requirements for an individual to receive a broker's license are that the individual: (a) Is 18 years of age or older; (b) Has a high school diploma or its equivalent; (c) Except as provided in RCW 18.85.141, has furnished proof, as the director may require, that the applicant has successfully completed 90 hours of instruction in real estate.

experience_source.quote: The minimum requirements for an individual to receive a broker's license are that the individual: (a) Is 18 years of age or older; (b) Has a high school diploma or its equivalent; (c) Except as provided in RCW 18.85.141, has furnished proof, as the director may require, that the applicant has successfully completed 90 hours of instruction in real estate.

exams.name: Broker's License Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must also pass a course examination for each approved course used to satisfy the broker's license requirement.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by the real estate commission throughout Washington state)
exams.quote: Has passed the broker's license examination.

exams.name: Managing Broker's License Examination
exams.notes: The managing broker's examination is more exacting than that for real estate brokers.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by the real estate commission throughout Washington state)
exams.quote: Has passed the managing broker's license examination.

interval_years.quote: Licenses must be renewed every two years on or before the date established under this section and a biennial renewal license fee as prescribed by the director by rule must be paid.

required.quote: All real estate brokers and managing brokers shall furnish proof as prescribed by rule of the director that they have successfully completed at least the required minimum number of 30 clock hours of instruction every two years in real estate courses approved by the director to renew their licenses.

hours_per_period.quote: successfully completed at least the required minimum number of 30 clock hours of instruction every two years

period_years.quote: 30 clock hours of instruction every two years

value: fair housing education and prevention of unfair practices (3 hours, or 6 hours for first renewal if not completed at initial licensure)
topical_requirements.quote: three hours of the required 30 hours of instruction in subsection (1) of this section must be focused on fair housing education and prevention of unfair practices with respect to real estate transactions, facilities, or services

available.quote: The director shall establish by rule standards for licensure of applicants licensed in other jurisdictions and for reciprocity including the use of written recognition agreements.

requirements.value: Out-of-state licensees with equivalent licenses may perform acts requiring a license with respect to commercial real estate if they work in cooperation with a Washington designated broker, enter into a written cooperation agreement, furnish their out-of-state license, consent to Washington jurisdiction, and comply with advertising and recordkeeping requirements.
requirements.quote: Persons with licenses deemed equivalent to licenses held by Washington licensees, as determined by the director, for a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, or in the expectation, or upon the promise of receiving or collecting a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration, may perform those acts that require a license under this chapter, with respect to commercial real estate, provided that the out-of-state licensee, as approved by the director, does all of the following

exists.quote: There is established the real estate commission of the state of Washington, consisting of the director who is the chair of the commission and six commission members who shall act in an advisory capacity to the director.

name.value: Real Estate Commission of the State of Washington
name.quote: There is established the real estate commission of the state of Washington

authority.value: Advisory capacity to the director; the director issues rules with the advice and approval of the commission; the commission conducts examinations of applicants for licenses and holds educational conferences.
authority.quote: six commission members who shall act in an advisory capacity to the director

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to act as a real estate broker, managing broker, or real estate firm without first obtaining a license therefor

credential_type.quote: It is unlawful for any person to act as a real estate broker, managing broker, or real estate firm without first obtaining a license therefor

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to act as a real estate broker, managing broker, or real estate firm without first obtaining a license therefor

title_protection.quote: Any person acting as a real estate broker, managing broker, or real estate firm, without a license, or violating any of the provisions of this chapter, is guilty of a gross misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to act as a real estate broker, managing broker, or real estate firm without first obtaining a license therefor, and otherwise complying with the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the real estate chapter or lawful rules, or provisions of chapters 64.36, 19.105, 18.235 RCW, or RCW 18.86.030.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the provisions of this chapter or any lawful rules made by the director pursuant thereto or violating a provision of chapter 64.36, 19.105, or 18.235 RCW or RCW 18.86.030

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or distributing false statements, descriptions, or promises reasonably likely to induce reliance, when the licensee knew or should have known of their falsity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making, printing, publishing, distributing, or causing, authorizing, or knowingly permitting the making, printing, publication or distribution of false statements, descriptions or promises of such character as to reasonably induce any person to act thereon

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly committing or participating in any material fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, conspiracy, collusion, trick, scheme, or device on which another person lawfully relies.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly committing, or being a party to, any material fraud, misrepresentation, concealment, conspiracy, collusion, trick, scheme, or device whereby any other person lawfully relies upon the word, representation or conduct of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting services from or continuing to employ a broker or managing broker who is unlicensed, whose license has been revoked, or whose license is suspended.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting the services of, or continuing in a representative capacity, any broker or managing broker who has not been granted a license, or after his or her license has been revoked or during a suspension thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Converting money, contracts, deeds, or other documents held in trust to personal use or failing to return them within 30 days after demand.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conversion of any money, contract, deed, note, mortgage, or abstract or other evidence of title, to the person's own use or to the use of that person's principal or of any other person, when delivered in trust or on condition, in violation of the trust or before the happening of the condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing, upon demand, to disclose information or produce documents for inspection by the director or authorized representatives.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, upon demand, to disclose any information within the person's knowledge, or to produce any document, book, or record in the person's possession for inspection by the director or the director's authorized representatives acting by authority of law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to sell real estate or operating according to a plan of selling after the director has stated written objections.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing to sell any real estate, or operating according to a plan of selling, whereby the interests of the public are endangered, after the director has, by order in writing, stated objections thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in any manner without including the real estate firm's name or assumed name in a clear and conspicuous manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising in any manner without including the real estate firm's name or assumed name as licensed in a clear and conspicuous manner in the advertisement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting other than cash or its equivalent as earnest money without communicating that fact to the owner before acceptance and showing it in the purchase and sale agreement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting other than cash or its equivalent as earnest money unless that fact is communicated to the owner before the owner's acceptance of the offer to purchase, and such fact is shown in the purchase and sale agreement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging or accepting compensation from more than one party in a transaction without full written disclosure of all facts to all interested parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging or accepting compensation from more than one party in any one transaction without first making full disclosure in writing of all the facts to all the parties interested in the transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, taking, or charging any undisclosed commission, rebate, or direct profit on expenditures made for the principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting, taking, or charging any undisclosed commission, rebate, or direct profit on expenditures made for the principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting employment or compensation for appraisal of real property contingent upon reporting a predetermined value.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting employment or compensation for appraisal of real property contingent upon reporting a predetermined value

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing a report on real property in which the licensee has an interest without clearly stating that interest in the report.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuing a report on any real property in which the broker, managing broker, or real estate firm has an interest unless that interest is clearly stated in the report

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting membership in any state or national real estate association.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of membership in any state or national real estate association

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discriminating against any person in hiring or real estate brokerage service activity on the basis of any applicable antidiscrimination law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discrimination against any person in hiring or in real estate brokerage service activity, on the basis of any of the provisions of any local, county, state, or federal antidiscrimination law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep an escrow or trustee account of deposited funds for three years, showing to whom paid and other pertinent information.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep an escrow or trustee account of funds deposited relating to a real estate transaction, for a period of three years, showing to whom paid, and other pertinent information as the director may require

disciplinary_grounds.description: In the case of a firm and its designated broker, failing to preserve records relating to any real estate transaction for three years following submission.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a firm and its designated broker, failing to preserve records relating to any real estate transaction for three years following the submission of the records to the firm

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish a copy of any listing, sale, lease, or other contract relevant to a real estate transaction to all signatories within a reasonable time after execution.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish a copy of any listing, sale, lease, or other contract relevant to a real estate transaction to all signatories thereof within a reasonable time following execution

disciplinary_grounds.description: For a broker or managing broker, accepting a commission or valuable consideration from any person other than the licensed real estate firm with whom they are licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a broker or managing broker, acceptance of a commission or any valuable consideration for the performance of any acts specified in this chapter, from any person, except the licensed real estate firm with whom the broker or managing broker is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directing a transaction to a lending institution or escrow company in expectation of receiving a kickback or rebate without first disclosing the expectation to the principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To direct any transaction involving his or her principal, to any lending institution for financing or to any escrow company, in expectation of receiving a kickback or rebate therefrom, without first disclosing the expectation to his or her principal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Buying, selling, or leasing any interest in real property without disclosing in writing that the person holds a real estate license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Buying, selling, or leasing directly, or through a third party, any interest in real property without disclosing in writing that the person is a real estate licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: For real estate firms and managing and designated brokers, failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of their brokers and managing brokers.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of real estate firms, and managing and designated brokers, failing to exercise adequate supervision over the activities of their brokers and managing brokers within the scope of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct in a real estate transaction that demonstrates bad faith, dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct in a real estate transaction which demonstrates bad faith, dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or incompetence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a vehicle dealer as defined in RCW 46.70.011 without holding a license to do so.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting as a vehicle dealer, as defined in RCW 46.70.011, without having a license to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to ensure that title is transferred under chapter 46.12 RCW when engaging in a transaction involving a mobile or manufactured home.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to ensure that the title is transferred under chapter 46.12 RCW when engaging in a transaction involving a mobile or manufactured home as a broker, managing or designated broker, or firm

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Every licensed real estate firm must have and maintain an office or records depositories accessible in this state to representatives of the director.

definition_quote.value: Real estate brokerage services means any of the following services offered or rendered directly or indirectly to another, or on behalf of another for compensation or the promise or expectation of compensation, or by a licensee on the licensee's own behalf: (a) Listing, selling, purchasing, exchanging, optioning, leasing, renting of real estate...; (b) Negotiating or offering to negotiate...; (c) Listing, selling, purchasing, exchanging, optioning, leasing, renting, or negotiating...a manufactured or mobile home in conjunction with the purchase, sale, lease, exchange, or rental of the land...; (d) Advertising or holding oneself out to the public by any solicitation or representation that one is engaged in real estate brokerage services; (e) Advising, counseling, or consulting buyers, sellers, landlords, or tenants in connection with a real estate transaction; (f) Issuing a broker's price opinion...; (g) Collecting, holding, or disbursing funds in connection with the negotiating, listing, selling, purchasing, exchanging, optioning, leasing, or renting of real estate...; and (h) Performing property management services
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate brokerage services" means any of the following services offered or rendered directly or indirectly to another, or on behalf of another for compensation or the promise or expectation of compensation, or by a licensee on the licensee's own behalf

license_tiers.quote: "Licensee" means a person holding a license as a real estate firm, managing broker, or broker.

broker_of_record_required.quote: Designates a managing broker as the "designated broker" who has authority to act for the firm, and provides the director with the name of the owner or owners or any others with a controlling interest in the firm

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: Has had a minimum of three years of licensed experience as a full-time real estate broker in this state or in another jurisdiction having comparable requirements within the five years previous to applying for the managing broker's license examination

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: has furnished proof, as the director may require, that the applicant has successfully completed 90 hours of instruction in real estate

practices
required_instruction_topics.quote: Instruction must include courses as prescribed by the director including fundamentals, which shall include three hours of instruction on fair housing and consumer protection issues, and practices.

inactive_license_max_years.quote: If a holder has an inactive license for more than three years, the holder must show proof of successfully completing a thirty clock hour course in real estate within one year before the application for active status.

value: seller's agent
buyer's agent
limited dual agent
agency_relationship_types.quote: "Buyer's agent" means a broker who has an agency relationship with only the buyer in a real estate transaction. ... "Seller's agent" means a broker who has an agency relationship with only the seller in a real estate transaction. ... "Limited dual agent" means a broker who has an agency relationship with both the buyer and seller in the same transaction.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A broker may act as a limited dual agent only with the written consent of both parties to the transaction, set forth in the services agreement.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: In a transaction in which different brokers affiliated with the same firm represent different parties, the firm's designated broker, and any managing broker responsible for the supervision of both brokers, is a limited dual agent. In such case, each appointed broker shall solely represent the party with whom the appointed broker has an agency relationship.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: To provide a pamphlet in the form prescribed by RCW 18.86.120 and obtain an acknowledgment of receipt by the party. The pamphlet shall be provided to: (i) Any party to whom the broker renders real estate brokerage services as soon as reasonably practical but before the party signs a services agreement

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A firm must enter into a services agreement with the principal before, or as soon as reasonably practical after, its appointed broker commences rendering real estate brokerage services to, or on behalf of, the principal.

value: agency disclosure (whether broker represents buyer, seller, or is limited dual agent)
any terms of compensation offered by a party or real estate firm to a real estate firm representing another party
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: To disclose in writing before the broker's principal signs an offer, or as soon as reasonably practical, but before the parties reach mutual agreement: (i) Whether the broker represents the buyer as the buyer's agent, the seller as the seller's agent, or both parties as a limited dual agent... and (ii) Any terms of compensation offered by a party or a real estate firm to a real estate firm representing another party.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: In the case of a firm and its designated broker, failing to preserve records relating to any real estate transaction for three years following the submission of the records to the firm

escrow_account_required.quote: Every real estate firm that keeps separate real estate trust fund accounts must keep the accounts in a recognized Washington state depository.

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: Brokers must deposit all funds into their firm's trust bank account the next banking day following receipt of the funds unless the purchase and sale agreement provides for deferred deposit or delivery.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: All licensees shall keep separate and apart and physically segregated from the licensees' own funds, all funds or moneys including advance fees of clients that are being held by the licensees pending the closing of a real estate sale or transaction

fixed_office_required.quote: Every licensed real estate firm must have and maintain an office or records depositories accessible in this state to representatives of the director.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Each branch office shall be required to have a branch manager who shall be a managing broker authorized by the designated broker to perform the duties of a branch manager.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: The broker is licensed to one firm at a time and is supervised by a designated or managing broker.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: Issuing a broker's price opinion. For the purposes of this chapter, "broker's price opinion" means an oral or written report of property value that is prepared by a licensee under this chapter and is not an appraisal as defined in RCW 18.140.010 unless it complies with the requirements established under chapter 18.140 RCW
